name: Candlelight: Christmas Classics
description: Christmas songs from Tchaikovsky to Mariah Carey, played by a string quartet by candlelight at Hilton Porto Gaia. Saturday 26 December at 19:30 and 21:30, tickets from €17.50.
longDescription:
A string quartet plays Christmas music by candlelight at Hilton Porto Gaia. The setlist mixes the traditional with the pop. Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy, Carol of the Bells and O Holy Night are on it, and so are Feliz Navidad, Last Christmas and All I Want for Christmas Is You. Let It Go, Once Upon a December and Hans Zimmer's Maestro from The Holiday are also in the programme.

It's a tribute concert, with no link to the original artists or their representatives. The show lasts 60 minutes and is for ages 8 and up. Under-16s must be accompanied by an adult.

There are two performances on Saturday 26 December, at 19:30 and 21:30, and tickets start at €17.50. Doors open 30 minutes before each show and close 5 minutes before it starts, with no late entry. Seats are given out in order of arrival within each ticket type. The venue is accessible for people with reduced mobility.
